validation_summary: MAQGC 4-axis composite (AFP 2019 QMJ KR-adapted) is family-orthogonal to FIAPAS as designed and AX-004 EXCLUSION compliant. Post-PIT-clean v2 (Codex C2/C3/C13/C15 fix) metrics dramatically improved: rank_ic 0.038 / Harvey-t 3.60 / ICIR 1.12 / D10-D1 +0.0033 / Subperiod 100% / DSR_post 1.00 — alpha clearly EXISTS at PIT-clean level. However graduation BORDERLINE: rank_ic 4.5% short of 0.04, monotonicity 13% short of 0.80. Cert cond4 (3-of-3 specs PASS Harvey-t) FAILS — S1 PASSES (3.60) but S2 (2.63) and S3 (2.58) marginally short. Honest non-issuance: cert NOT ISSUED for consistency with FIAPAS V2 standards. Iter 11 path: residualize MAQGC vs Q08 (cor 0.723), focus on S1 single-spec, evaluate standalone A4 (CashFlowQuality) ICIR 1.22. KEY LESSON L-224: PIT-C13 manual sign flip is NOT signal-equivalent to Z_Score_Aligned — manual override actively HARMS signal because Z_Aligned captures regime changes via expanding-window IC. Iter 10 B alpha is honest non-promotion at cert level but valuable Iter 11 input.
